trace.question: For the patients with a normal range of creatinine phosphokinase, how many of them have a positive measure of degree of coagulation?
trace.evidence: normal range of creatinine phosphokinase refers to CPK < 250; positive measure of degree of coagulation refers to KCT = '+' or RVVT = '+' or LAC = '+' ;

attempts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.CPK < 250
  AND (e.KCT = '+' OR e.RVVT = '+' OR e.LAC = '+')

trace.final_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.CPK < 250
  AND (e.KCT = '+' OR e.RVVT = '+' OR e.LAC = '+')
trace.answer: One patient has a normal creatinine phosphokinase level and a positive measure of coagulation.
